_comment: Darwin (Apple Silicon) incumbent pin for future vs-incumbent Metal claims.
The x86 contract (INCUMBENT_CONTRACT.json) pins a vendored CPU build;
on macOS the honest incumbent is whisper.cpp's Metal path, which is the
deployment users actually compare against. No competitive ratio has been
published against this pin yet: the 2026-08-11 ledger rows using this
binary are explicitly NON-CAMPAIGN scale references taken on a loaded
multi-agent host. A decidable row additionally requires a quiet M-series
host (the same per-CPU quiescence discipline as the x86 harness) and an
A/A-nulled, order-alternating harness on darwin — examples/incumbent_ab.rs
is Linux-only today (procfs/sysfs quiescence gates), so a darwin harness
port is a prerequisite and is tracked on bd-453z.
Updating this incumbent is legal; updating it silently is not: bump the
digests here in the same commit.
Metal-enabled: this is the incumbent at its strongest on Apple
Silicon. ggml_metal_device_init reports tensor API disabled for
pre-M5 devices on the recording host (M4 Pro).

matched_decode_invocation: _comment: matched greedy (-bs 1 -bo 1) per the measurement contract;
state decode parameters explicitly on every row.

_comment: Recording host only. Ratios published against this pin must name their
